map.基于90分钟睡眠周期原理，计算最佳入睡和起床时间: Calculate the best bedtime and wake time based on the 90-minute sleep cycle principle
map.入睡时刻 = 起床时刻 − (周期数 × 90 分钟 + 入睡耗时): Bedtime = wake time − (cycles × 90 minutes + sleep latency)
map.以 90 分钟为一个完整睡眠周期，从起床时刻向前倒推 3–6 个周期: With 90 minutes as one complete sleep cycle, count back 3-6 cycles from the wake time

map.计算应该在什么时间入睡，才能在起床时刚好完成完整睡眠周期: Calculate when to fall asleep so that you complete whole sleep cycles by wake time
map.计算如果现在入睡，应该在什么时间起床最合适: Calculate the best wake time if you fall asleep now
map.从上床到实际睡着需要的时间，一般人约15分钟: Time from getting into bed to actually falling asleep; about 15 minutes for most people
map.人的睡眠由多个周期组成，每个周期约90分钟，包含非快速眼动睡眠（NREM）和快速: Human sleep consists of multiple cycles, each about 90 minutes, including non-rapid eye movement (NREM) and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep.
map.在周期结束时醒来，会感觉神清气爽；在周期中间被叫醒，会感到昏沉疲倦（睡眠惯性）。: Waking at the end of a cycle leaves you refreshed; being woken mid-cycle leaves you groggy and tired (sleep inertia).
map.第1阶段 - 浅睡眠，易惊醒，约5-10分钟: Stage 1 - light sleep, easily startled awake, about 5-10 minutes
map.第2阶段 - 睡眠加深，心率减慢，约50%睡眠时间: Stage 2 - sleep deepens, heart rate slows, about 50% of sleep time
map.第3-4阶段 - 深度睡眠，身体修复，最难唤醒: Stages 3-4 - deep sleep, body repair, hardest to wake from
map.快速眼动睡眠 - 做梦，大脑整理记忆: Rapid eye movement sleep - dreaming, the brain organizing memories
map.为什么周期结束时醒来最好？: Why is waking at the end of a cycle best?
map.• 在浅睡期或REM期结束时醒来，大脑已处于相对活跃状态: • Waking at the end of light sleep or REM leaves the brain relatively active
map.• 从深睡中被叫醒会产生\"睡眠惰性\"，可能持续2-4小时: • Waking from deep sleep causes "sleep inertia" that may last 2-4 hours
map.• 即使睡眠时间稍短，只要周期完整，醒来感觉更好: • Even with slightly less sleep, waking feels better as long as the cycles are complete
map.每天同一时间睡觉和起床，包括周末: sleep and wake at the same time every day, including weekends
map.睡前1小时避免电子设备，可阅读、冥想、听轻音乐: avoid electronic devices 1 hour before bed; you can read, meditate or listen to soft music
map.卧室保持黑暗、安静、凉爽（18-22℃最佳）: keep the bedroom dark, quiet and cool (18-22°C is best)
map.下午2点后不喝咖啡因，睡前3小时不进食、不剧烈运动: no caffeine after 2 pm; no food or strenuous exercise 3 hours before bed
map.白天规律运动有助于睡眠，但避免睡前运动: regular daytime exercise helps sleep, but avoid exercising before bed
map.倒时差调整方法: How to adjust to jet lag
map.• 出发前3天，每天提前1小时睡觉和起床: • For 3 days before departure, go to bed and wake up 1 hour earlier each day
map.• 早上接受强光照射，帮助生物钟提前: • Get bright light in the morning to help advance the body clock
map.• 到达后立即适应当地时间，白天多晒太阳: • Adapt to local time immediately on arrival and get plenty of sun during the day
map.• 出发前3天，每天推迟1小时睡觉和起床: • For 3 days before departure, go to bed and wake up 1 hour later each day
map.• 傍晚接受强光照射，帮助生物钟推迟: • Get bright light in the evening to help delay the body clock
map.• 到达后第一天尽量保持清醒到当地晚上: • On the first day after arrival, try to stay awake until local evening
map.熬夜后如何恢复: How to recover after an all-nighter
map.第二天最多比平时晚起1-2小时，避免打乱生物钟: wake up no more than 1-2 hours later than usual the next day to avoid disrupting the body clock
map.中午小睡20-30分钟，不要超过1小时: nap for 20-30 minutes at midday; do not exceed 1 hour
map.熬夜会脱水，多喝水有助于恢复: staying up late causes dehydration; drinking more water aids recovery
map.避免高糖高脂，多吃蔬菜水果: avoid high sugar and fat; eat more vegetables and fruit
map.白天轻度运动帮助提神，但避免剧烈运动: light daytime exercise helps you stay alert, but avoid strenuous exercise
map.不要试图一次补回来，逐步调整回正常作息: do not try to catch up all at once; adjust back to a normal routine gradually
map.20-30分钟（避免进入深睡，醒来更累）: 20-30 minutes (avoid entering deep sleep, which makes waking more tiring)
map.下午1-3点（与生物钟低谷一致）: 1-3 pm (matching the body clock's low point)
map.压迫眼球和面部，建议平躺或靠椅: it presses on the eyes and face; lying flat or leaning back in a chair is recommended
map.晚上失眠的人白天不要午睡: those with night insomnia should not nap during the day
map.本计算器结果仅供参考，不能替代专业医生的诊断和建议。睡眠需求因人而异，如长期失眠: This calculator's results are for reference only and cannot replace a professional doctor's diagnosis and advice. Sleep needs vary between individuals; if you have long-term insomnia or poor sleep quality, consult a professional doctor.
map.按起床时间反推入睡：输入目标起床时间，工具以 90 分钟为一个睡眠周期、并预留约: Back-calculate bedtime from wake time: enter the target wake time and the tool uses 90 minutes per sleep cycle plus about 15 minutes of sleep latency to back-calculate several acceptable bedtimes.
map.优先推荐完整周期数：5 个周期(7.5h)、6 个周期(9h)为推荐区间；4 个: Prefer whole cycles: 5 cycles (7.5h) and 6 cycles (9h) are the recommended range; 4 cycles (6h) is on the low side and 3 cycles (4.5h) is insufficient, both flagged.
map.减少醒后困倦：在周期末尾（浅睡期）醒来比在深睡期被叫醒更清醒，按周期安排作息可减: Reduce grogginess on waking: waking at the end of a cycle (light sleep) is clearer than being woken in deep sleep; scheduling by cycles eases "sleep inertia".
map.算例：07:00 起床、入睡潜伏期 15 分钟: Example: wake at 07:00, sleep latency 15 minutes
map.推荐入睡：21:45（6 周期 9h）、23:15（5 周期 7.5h）；可接受: Recommended bedtimes: 21:45 (6 cycles, 9h) and 23:15 (5 cycles, 7.5h); acceptable 00:45 (4 cycles, 6h); insufficient 02:15 (3 cycles, 4.5h). All are back-calculated from the wake time using 90-minute cycles + 15 minutes of sleep latency.
map.成人睡眠由浅睡-深睡-REM 循环组成，每轮约 90 分钟。在周期切换的浅睡点醒: Adult sleep consists of light-deep-REM loops of about 90 minutes each. Waking at the light-sleep point of a cycle switch is easiest to wake from; this is an empirical average and individual variation exists.
map.一定要睡满 7.5 小时吗？: Must I sleep a full 7.5 hours?
map.多数成人 7-9 小时较合适，关键是规律与完整周期。偶尔 6 小时可行，长期不足: 7-9 hours suits most adults; the key is regularity and complete cycles. An occasional 6 hours is fine, but chronic short sleep accumulates sleep debt and affects attention and metabolism.
